If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast peak by 1.5–2.5% in mid-horizon (days 15–25) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast trough by 1.5–2.5% in early-horizon (days 1–10) to avoid pessimism.  
If sentiment swings sharply (≥0.33 and ≤1.00) in the last 3 days, adjust forecast slope downward by 0.5–1.0% in late-horizon (days 25–30) to reflect volatility.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price history shows strong upward trend, reduce forecast peak by 1.0–2.0% in mid-horizon to prevent momentum overcorrection.  
If sentiment is neutral and price history shows strong downward trend, reduce forecast trough by 1.0–2.0% in early-horizon to prevent momentum undercorrection.  
If sentiment is mixed (alternating 0.33–1.00) and forecast deviates >3% from true path, apply linear correction to forecast path by -0.5% per 3-day sentiment shift.
